site_recommendation.lede: 在呼和浩特旧城，大召把藏传佛教的经堂与汉式殿宇连成一体。寺院因银佛得名，现存建筑还叠加着清代改修的痕迹；图版只画大雄宝殿，不把整座召庙压缩成一座山门。
facts: 寺院沿革 明代阿拉坦汗主持营建，1580年寺成；此后清代屡有改修。
所绘主体 以明确标注的大雄宝殿实拍为准，保留汉藏结合的经堂、佛殿体量。
断代说明 现貌包含明清营建与修缮层次；年表使用约略位置，不将寺院初建年等同每个现存构件的年代。

BLACK INK lines only. No filled black or grey areas, no gradients, cast shadow, grey matte, paper grain, colored lines, glow, checkerboard, lettering, watermark, labels, captions or comparison panel. The white canvas will later be removed with the project's local script.

Preserve the two broad roof levels, upper balcony and central steps. Specifically hollow out the two black upper balcony openings and all black lower door/passages behind the columns. Keep the currently drawn window lattice. Landscape 1536x1024.
